caseName: Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen & Enginemen v. Bangor & Aroostook Railroad
caseNameFull: Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen & Enginemen v. Bangor & Aroostook Railroad Co.
attorneys: Joseph L. Rauh, Jr., John Silard, Elliott C. Lichtman, and Isaac N. Oroner for petitioner. Francis M. Shea, Richard T. Conway, and James A. Wilcox for respondents.

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted. The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
